band.why: Smoke-level plausibility band chosen for #752, not a standard: the exported model has its own geometry, glazing and zoning, so only a gross miss (a broken load, a missing construction, an absurd schedule) should leave it.

unmet_hours_limit.source: ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix G, G3.1.2.3 (unmet load hours for the proposed and baseline designs shall not exceed 300); reported, not enforced

references.produced_by: python sim_smoke.py --reference-only --building-type SmallOffice --template 90.1-2019 --climate-zone 5A (sim/prototype.rb, then an annual run)
